description: Open-web searches and selected news pages do not reproduce the official baseline or LexisNexis newspaper search. Month coverage cannot be called exhaustive.
required_followup: Official baseline/licensing and equivalent archive access remain coordinator-level open gates.

description: 8M Santiago attendance reports conflict sharply: about 25,000 attributed to Carabineros versus more than 400,000 attributed to organizers. Current record uses the lower published estimate for the threshold and preserves the full reported range; no independent reconciliation.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous independent estimate with clear attribution if available; do not sum regional counts.

description: BioBio names multiple regional 8M marches and some local counts, while national accounts discuss policy demands. Site-level organization/demand linkage is less detailed outside Santiago; locations are preserved without adding attendance.
required_followup: If separate local coding is considered, verify same-site demand, count and organizing relationship for each city.

description: T13 identifies Deutsche Welle as the Mochilazo story origin; treat the two as one written-origin account. La Tercera corroborates occurrence/demands but has no crowd estimate. EFE Valparaíso report appears as repeated photo captions and is a single origin.
required_followup: Independent, different-origin crowd evidence remains desirable, especially for Valparaíso March 15.

description: The March 16 Valparaíso Confusam demonstration is documented, but no simultaneous attendance count is provided. The 5,000 figure refers to affected workers, not attendance.
required_followup: Find a permitted report with a count at this site/date; do not infer from strike adhesions or workforce.

description: Valparaíso student blockade (March 28) and Día del Joven Combatiente-related demonstrations (March 29) remain discovery-only; no body-level confirmation of attendance/demand.
required_followup: Open only after fresh exact-URL access check and manual assessment; verify body/date/site, >50 simultaneous and own-state demand.

description: Exact end dates/times and full government responses are unknown for most events. Do not infer completion from publication dates, one-day framing, strike duration, silence or partial reporting.
required_followup: Use explicit closure/complete retrospective accounts and event-specific state response evidence only.
